title: VBRC Base By Base: Search for Sequence Motifs
author: Nick Tang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.eczbax6

steps.title: Select sequences to search
steps.instruction: In the Sequence List, click the names of the DNA sequences you wish to search; hold down the CTRL key (Windows) or Apple key (Mac) to select multiple sequences.

steps.title: Run exact regular‑expression search
steps.instruction: Open the Tools menu, choose Search → Regular Expression Search, then type the exact motif (CCTGGC) into the expression box and start the search.

steps.title: Run fuzzy motif search
steps.instruction: Open the Tools menu, choose Search → Fuzzy Motif Search, enter the motif (CCTGGC) and set the maximum number of mismatches to 1, then start the search.

steps.title: Inspect and save search results
steps.instruction: When the search finishes, a list of matches is displayed; double‑click any entry to jump to that location. For fuzzy searches, click “Save Fuzzy Results” to export the list to a text file.
